tech_stack.frontend: Custom ASP.NET-style server-rendered site behind Cloudflare (cf-ray DFW), jQuery 1.x + validate.min.js + Cloudflare Turnstile captcha
tech_stack.backend: Not exposed — informational directory site, no public API of its own

ml_model_infrastructure.model_types: None — it is a comparison/review directory for sports data vendors, not a data provider itself

data_supply_chain.vendors: Aggregates third-party vendor listings: FantasyNerds, FantasyData.com, CricketAPI, FootballAPI, StatPal, GoalServe, API-Sports.io, SportMonks, The Odds API, JsonOdds, HorseAPI, Broker Sports; also lists BetRadar, BettingData.com, AllSports API, BallDontLie

product_limits.limits: Site monetizes via 'Pricing Tool — Unlock 25% Off Plans' affiliate/discount deals with vendors; Login section present (login wall for accounts)

pricing.web: No own pricing; publishes third-party vendor prices (e.g. API-Sports.io $19/mo, API-Tennis $40/mo, APIFootball $15/mo, AllSports API $79/mo, BettingData.com $99/mo, Broker Sports $48/mo) — citation https://sportsapi.com/api-directory

discovery_metadata.method: urllib GET: home/robots/docs/api + api-directory crawl + subdomain DNS probes (api/app/staging all NXDOMAIN)
